## Line 184

```plato

    // The cross product: the vector perpendicular to both operands, with
    // magnitude equal to the area of the parallelogram they span.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_product
    Cross(self: Vector3D, right: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (self.Y * right.Z - self.Z * right.Y,
            self.Z * right.X - self.X * right.Z,
            self.X * right.Y - self.Y * right.X);
```
